messages:
Rae (docs): opened PR #5650 to tighten the migration guide and swap the old sync embed snippet for the new JS streaming example. quick heads-up: found a couple of live-looking tokens in a copied test file. will not merge until redacted.
Noah (platform): can you paste the preview link once CI runs? I want to confirm the sidebar anchors after the heading rename.
Rae (docs): copying the snippet that needs redaction:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: 'sk_test_51fakeTOKENabc123', kmsKey: 'arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999988887777:key/ffee-1122' });
await client.streamEmbeds(['hello']);
```
Hannah (sdk): yep redact both. prefer placeholders: `REPLACE_WITH_API_KEY` and `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID`. also add a quick comment in the snippet showing how to load from env vars.
Ivy (security): please open a sensitive-docs request and mark as example-credentials + leaked-secrets. I'll triage and aim for same-day review, but legal needs to sign off on wording.
Rae (docs): RD-402 created and linked to PR #5650. added an advisory card about not pasting live credentials into docs or CI artifacts. pushing placeholder changes now.
sensitive-docs-bot: RD-402 created for PR #5650 — status: pending triage
docs-preview-bot: preview build queued for PR #5650 — https://ci.example.com/builds/5650
examples-lint-bot: examples linter flagged example formatting (missing env comment) and a potential external link that redirects.
Noah (platform): platform build shows a link-check warning on the API-ref anchor due to renaming. I can add a redirect rule, but won't block the redaction fix.
Hannah (sdk): pushed local change to show env var usage in the snippet and replaced tokens with placeholders. if someone can run a fresh preview that would help.
Rae (docs): pushed the same to the PR. retriggering preview.
docs-preview-bot: preview build failed for PR #5650 — failing check: docs-lint (link-check) — https://ci.example.com/builds/5650
Rae (docs): hmm link-check still failing, CI log points to a stale redirect. Noah can you regenerate the index?
Noah (platform): I'm on it. also will bump the link-check cache to force fresh crawling.
Ivy (security): RD-402 triaged: security quick-pass after placeholders in examples. passing to legal for advisory wording approval.
Diego (legal): draft advisory looks good. tiny tone edit: prefer "avoid pasting" over "do not paste". will leave formal approval in PR comments.
Noah (platform): regenerated link index and kicked a clean preview build.
docs-preview-bot: preview succeeded for PR #5650 — https://ci.example.com/builds/5650/preview
examples-lint-bot: examples linter cleared.
Ivy (security): security approves RD-402. :white_check_mark:
Diego (legal): legal approves the advisory language and left a short comment in the PR.
Hannah (sdk): ran a local preview to double-check the streaming snippet behavior — looks good. added a tiny comment in the example recommending env var usage for CI.
Rae (docs): thanks all. plan is to merge during docs merge window tomorrow at 08:45 PT after a 15-minute post-approval wait for any last-minute holds. will file a repo-wide sweep ticket to scan for other literal-looking keys and tokens. Noah — can you own the sweep?
Noah (platform): yep I'll own the sweep. will wire up a grep job and follow-up PRs for any hits. scheduling for next sprint.
sensitive-docs-bot: RD-402 status updated — resolved (redaction confirmed, security OK, legal OK).
docs-preview-bot: deploy queued for main (PR #5650) — will publish after merge.
Rae (docs): merging in the 08:45 PT window. will add a release note callout about the migration guide changes and the credentials advisory. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
